summary_text: Primary Earnings Catalysts: 1) Norfolk Southern Merger Approval - $85 billion merger undergoing regulatory review by STB, could create first truly transcontinental US railroad, reducing handoff delays by ~35%. 2) Operational Efficiency - PSR 2.0 model delivering industry-leading metrics; Q1 net income $1.7B up 5% YoY, EPS $2.87 up 6%, operating income and net income set first-quarter records. 3) Forward Guidance - Management reiterated 2026 plan for mid-single-digit EPS growth, continued operating-ratio gains (including merger costs, no buybacks), 3-year EPS CAGR target of high single-digit to low double-digit through 2027. 4) Fuel Trends - merger approval and fuel trends emerging as next key catalysts. Next earnings date estimated July 23, 2026.
